proposals.entity_key: Past conditional for regret or reproach

evidence.notes: Source gives aurais dû + infinitive and lists aimer, devoir, vouloir as the verbs expressing regret or reproach in the conditionnel passé; the forms instantiate each. Low uncertainty.

proposals.entity_key: Past conditional for unconfirmed past information (journalistic)
value: elle se serait installée à Lyon

evidence.notes: Source states the past conditional serves as conditionnel journalistique for unconfirmed statements and lists voler, s'installer, gracier, faire among the verbs; the forms instantiate the reported/alleged reading. Low uncertainty.

proposals.entity_key: Past conditional with si clause in plus-que-parfait
value: Si j'avais su, j'aurais agi autrement.
Si elle était partie plus tôt, elle aurait pris le train.

evidence.notes: Source gives the pattern si + plus-que-parfait with a past conditional main clause and warns against the past conditional in the si clause; both examples keep the si clause in the plus-que-parfait. Low uncertainty.

Source states the infinitif passé is formed with the infinitive of avoir or être plus the past participle of the main verb, with participle agreement when the auxiliary is être; the pairs show both auxiliaries. Low uncertainty.

proposals.entity_key: Past participle agreement with preceding direct object (que)
value: C'est la table en marbre que nous avons trouvée au marché aux puces.
La pièce qu'il a écrite n'a jamais été jouée.
Montrez-moi la photo que vous avez prise.

evidence.notes: Source gives exactly these sentences as examples of the past participle agreeing with a preceding direct object introduced by que; reproduced to respect the 3-item limit. Low uncertainty.
Source states the past participle of être-verbs agrees in gender and number with the subject and gives Elle est arrivée en retard; arriver and naître are the listed verbs. Low uncertainty.

value: Je pense qu'il vient. -> Je ne pense pas qu'il vienne.
Je crois que Daniel est coupable. -> Je ne crois pas que Daniel soit coupable.

evidence.notes: Source gives the affirmative indicative and the negative subjunctive pair Je ne crois pas que Daniel est coupable / Je ne crois pas que Daniel soit coupable, noting the subjunctive is optional and marks uncertainty; pairs show the mood shift. Low uncertainty.

Source lists ayant vu, ayant compris, étant allé(e)(s) as forms of the participe passé composé and gives the negative n'ayant pas + past participle; the three items cover avoir, être agreement, and negation. Low uncertainty.

proposals.entity_key: Placement of short adverbs in passé composé

evidence.notes: Source states short adverbs of quantity, quality, and frequency go between the auxiliary and the past participle and gives Elle a beaucoup étudié; the other two use listed adverbs trop and souvent. Low uncertainty.
Source gives deux cents, trois cents, and the no-s case deux cent trois; the three items instantiate both branches of the rule. Low uncertainty.
